title: XMRig_Cryptominer_Investigation_c4b
description: Investigate unauthorized cryptocurrency mining activity on Linux servers.
outcomes: Identifying log files created by malware
Identifying remote access used for lateral movement
Confirming compromise of initially infected host
Confirming compromise of laterally infected host

levels.title: Introduction
levels.content: The IT department has received reports of unusually high CPU usage on several Linux servers in the network. Initial investigation suggests this might be caused by unauthorized cryptocurrency mining activity. Your task is to investigate these systems, identify the source of the problem, and contain the threat.

levels.title: Get Access
levels.cloud_content:
You have SSH access to the following systems with the username `cyrano` and password `cyrano`:
- `miner-host` (192.168.50.5)
- `second-host` (192.168.50.6)
Enter `start` to begin the investigation.

levels.solution: Check the status of all running services and look for any that appear unusual or out of place. The service name is `sys-monitor`.

levels.content: Collect forensic evidence supporting the identified cryptomining activity on the `miner-host` system.

- Service name: `sys-monitor`
- Process name: `sys-monitor`
- Filename: `/usr/local/sbin/xmrig`
- Filename: `/tmp/.installer`
- IP address: `185.183.98.46`

- Mining pool IP address and port number: `192.168.40.5:3333`
